pages.text: $(bold)Spell Break$() (comes with Mithril, $(bold)no levels$())$(br2)The tool $(bold)comes with a level 1 Counterspell$() inscribed (an Iron's Spells spell that interrupts enemy casting or magic effects).$(br2)It is written into the item's $(bold)spell container$(), which means:$(li)the Arcane Anvil $(bold)can keep editing it$() (add or upgrade spells)$(li)together with Arcane Conduction you can raise that Counterspell to a higher level$(br2)Items that already carry a container are never overwritten, so manual edits stay intact.
